ada.subtitle: The Lone Bunny of Paradise
ada.description: Two sets of memories live behind her smile: a homeland torn apart by war, and a paradise that may never have existed. She walks between them, never saying which one is hers.
ada.name: Ada

flora.subtitle: Rebel Bloom
flora.description: Beneath petals of onyx simmers a slow wrath. Each thorn marks a broken oath; each blossom, a deferred reckoning. Night opens to her passage like a garden someone forgot to lock.

hilda.subtitle: Crimson Apron
hilda.description: Beneath the spotless linens of a maid in service to a noble house sleep the tools of a fidelity sharper than stone. When silence falls, her blades do the speaking.
hilda.name: Hilda

nvzhu02.subtitle: Shadow's Reflection
nvzhu02.description: The other side of fate: where the light fades, another voice rises. She walks the abyss wearing the same face, but different oaths — and this time she chooses not to turn back.
nvzhu02.name: Female Protagonist

nanzhu02.subtitle: Echo in Ink
nanzhu02.description: What you think you left behind sometimes returns, dressed as yourself. Beneath the mantle of shadow rest unkept promises, and a quiet step that no longer asks for forgiveness.
nanzhu02.name: Male Protagonist

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy and terms of use of the DNA Interactive community build builder.
privacy.title: Privacy & terms
privacy.intro: Applies to Discord sign-in and the community build builder.
privacy.data1: Discord ID, nickname and avatar (to identify you as an author).
privacy.data2: Your Discord email, if you allow it at sign-in.
privacy.data3: The builds, drafts and votes you create on the site.
privacy.dataNote: This account data is not used for advertising and is not sold. Audience measurement is described separately below.
privacy.purposeText: This data is only used to run accounts and build sharing (authentication, attributing a build to its author, votes, moderation). It is kept as long as your account exists and is deleted when you delete your account.
privacy.analyticsText: We use Sarutobi, a self-hosted solution, to measure pages and journeys, sources and campaigns, approximate country, device and browser, Web Vitals, redacted JavaScript errors and selected product actions. A pseudonymous session identifier is used; when you are signed in, it may be linked to your internal account ID. No email, password, nickname, search, build content or form value is sent. Retention depends on the project configuration.
privacy.optOutText: Measurement starts on your first visit, without a banner. You can object at any time; the choice is kept in this browser.
privacy.optOutActive: Audience measurement is active in this browser.
privacy.optOutDisabled: Audience measurement is disabled in this browser.
privacy.optOutNote: This setting is stored locally: it does not follow your account and must be set again in another browser or after clearing site data.
privacy.rightsText: At any time you can view your data, edit or delete your builds, and permanently delete your account (together with all your builds, drafts and votes) from your profile. Deletion is immediate and irreversible.
privacy.ugc1: You remain responsible for the builds and names you publish.
privacy.ugc2: Build names and notes must not contain hateful speech, harassment, illegal content or spam.
privacy.ugc3: A build can be reported by the community; an administrator may hide or delete it, and ban an account in case of repeated abuse.
privacy.ugc4: By publishing a build, you agree that it is displayed publicly on the site with your Discord nickname and avatar.
privacy.contactText: For any question about your data or the removal of content, use the <link>contact</link> page.

itemsAbout.title: How Demon Wedges work
itemsAbout.intro: In game, Demon Wedges may also appear under the technical name <mod>MOD</mod> in some data. This page explains the key fields used across the site: level, affinity, tolerance, dynamic effects and asset mapping.
itemsAbout.showcaseDescription: Examples of Demon Wedge icons used in the grid and the detail page. The goal is to recognise a Demon Wedge at a glance.
itemsAbout.readStep1Text: Lets you identify the Demon Wedge in the grid.
itemsAbout.readStep2Text: The symbol next to the name shows the Demon Wedge affinity type.
itemsAbout.readStep3Text: The detail slider changes the dynamic values #1, #2, #3.
itemsAbout.structureItem1: Every Demon Wedge has a name, a description, a rarity, an affinity and a max level.
itemsAbout.structureItem2: The name shown in game is <c>Demon Wedge</c>. <c>MOD</c> remains mostly a technical term used in some internal data.
itemsAbout.structureItem3: Texts (name, description, passive effects) change with the selected language.
itemsAbout.structureItem4: The site exposes this info as JSON so you can filter, compare languages and open details.
itemsAbout.affinityDescription: The detail sheet combines several visual cues: polarity symbol, elemental affinity and compatibility tags for the character/weapon type.
itemsAbout.levelsText: The values <c>#1</c>, <c>#2</c>, etc. change with the Demon Wedge level. The slider on the detail page applies those values from the growth table and shows the effect at the chosen level.
itemsAbout.toleranceText: The displayed tolerance scales with level. The formula exposed in the data is:
itemsAbout.toleranceNote: The site pre-computes per-level values and stores them in <c>tolerance.valuesByLevel</c>.
itemsAbout.multilangText: On the grid: you can show several languages at once to compare names. On the detail: a single language can be picked and shared through the URL.
itemsAbout.multilangNote: The languages currently available depend on the dataset loaded for the category.
itemsAbout.displayItem1: General Demon Wedge info (name, rarity, function, description)
itemsAbout.displayItem5: Search, filters, favourites and pagination for navigation
itemsAbout.quickTitle: Reading a Demon Wedge at a glance on the site
itemsAbout.quickText: The visual path is always the same: identify the icon, check the affinity, then adjust the level to see the dynamic effects.
itemsAbout.nextText: Use the grid to filter and compare quickly, then open an item to see its dynamic values, its per-level tolerance and its affinity.
itemsAbout.genericText: This category is ready to host a detailed explanatory page. The system is already in place to add the rules, formulas and visuals specific to each new item family.
itemsAbout.metaModsDescription: Understand how Demon Wedges work: levels, affinity, tolerance, translations and reading the effects.
itemsAbout.metaGenericDescription: Understand how {category} works: levels, affinity, tolerance, translations and reading the effects.

calamityGuide.title: Understanding calamity weapons
calamityGuide.intro: In the game data, a calamity weapon is a weapon whose technical subtype is <c>Hyper</c>. It has a Calamity Fusion progression from 0 to 5, Weapon Potentials, and one strict rule: the Potential only works if the character masters that weapon type.
calamityGuide.catalogCount: Hyper weapons out of {total} local weapons
calamityGuide.badgePotentialOnly: Potential active only with the signature weapon
calamityGuide.noDescription: No localised description available in the current extract.
calamityGuide.adjustHint: Adjust the Fusion track (tier {label}) to lock / unlock

0.label: Base
0.title: Weapon obtained
0.body: The weapon is equippable and its base potential exists, but the forge path is not upgraded yet.

1.title: Calamity Furnace I
1.body: First Calamity Fusion tier. Costs start using the prototype of the weapon involved.

2.title: Calamity Furnace II
2.body: The path adds potentials or stat bonuses tied to the HyperWeaponSkillTree.

3.title: Calamity Furnace III
3.body: Potential branches advance. Effects remain conditioned by the character's signature weapon.

4.title: Calamity Furnace IV
4.body: The big branch bonuses become available once the global furnace level keeps up.

5.title: Calamity Furnace V
5.body: Final tier currently exposed by the local tables: maximum fusion level 5.

calamityGuide.factFusionBody: Calamity Fusion raises the weapon's fusion level. The local tables expose tiers 1 to 5 via <c>HyperWeaponCardLevel</c>.
calamityGuide.factPotentialBody: Potentials are unlocked through fusion. In the game text, they only take effect if the weapon type matches the character's signature weapon.
calamityGuide.factLimitBody: The UI text states that a character can equip only one Calamity Weapon at a time.
calamityGuide.factNotConsonanceBody: Calamity weapons are the <c>Hyper</c> weapons. The <c>*Ultra</c> keys in Demon Wedges refer to Consonance weapons.
calamityGuide.costText: The costs below come from the <c>HyperWeaponCardLevel</c> table. Steel weapons currently expose a minimal Phoxene cost in the local data.
calamityGuide.costNotExposed: Cost not exposed for this tier in the current extract.
calamityGuide.wedgesText: The site's weapon sheet can display a canonical Demon Wedge build. For <n>{name}</n>, the compatible pool is <c>{poolKey}</c>, i.e. {poolLabel}.
calamityGuide.dataWeaponBody: <c>WeaponSubType = Hyper</c> identifies calamity weapons. That is the signal used for this sheet.
calamityGuide.dataBattleWeaponBody: Combat stats come from <c>BattleWeapon</c>: ATK, ATK type, crit and potential-related bonuses.
calamityGuide.dataSkillTreeBody: <c>HyperWeaponSkillTree</c> describes the known potential branches for Perpetual Conflict and Requiem of Thorns.
calamityGuide.dataCardLevelBody: <c>HyperWeaponCardLevel</c> gives the fusion tiers, furnace conditions and resources.
calamityGuide.phoxeneNote: Minimal cost currently exposed for this steel weapon in the local tables.
calamityGuide.metaDescription: Understand Duet Night Abyss calamity weapons: Calamity Fusion, Weapon Potentials, mastery prerequisites and Demon Wedge builds.

v2_3_0.title: Ada joins the database: version 1.5, new weapons, and the site translated into 7 languages
v2_3_0.description: All site data has been regenerated from game version 1.5. Three new weapons arrive with their forge components, the Demon Wedge database grows substantially, and the whole site is now translated into all 7 languages — including page titles and detail pages.
items: 🌊 **Ada** joins the character database — Hydro, 5★, “The Lone Bunny of Paradise”, with her stats, skills and artwork
⚔️ Three new weapons: The Best Day, Sanguis Sanctus – Pistol and Obsidian Heart-Reaper, with their artwork
🔨 Their forge components added to the blueprints (barrel, frame, blade, grip…)
💠 The Demon Wedge database grows from 738 to 829 entries
🎁 New resources: Starglow Coin, selection chests, Paradise Accessory Coupon, Geniemon Medal
🐟 Game-side translation fix: the “pearl shark” is in fact a “pearl ray”
🌍 Site fully translated into 7 languages: page titles and descriptions, character and item pages, map, interface
🔤 Displayed game data now falls back to English instead of French when your language is unavailable
🏷️ The version badge in the menu now reads 1.5

v2_2_0.title: New interface: a home page that brings everything together, clearer and livelier
v2_2_0.description: The site interface has been fully reworked to be more readable, more pleasant and faster to browse. A new home page gathers every tool in one place, a side menu stays within reach, and pages now use the full screen — on desktop and mobile alike.
items: 🏠 New “hub” home that shows everything at a glance: map, characters, database, builder, builds, codes and tools
📋 Side menu always available to jump between sections in one click — collapsible when you want more room, and it remembers your preference
🖥️ Every page redesigned to use the full screen: airier, more readable, less empty space
🎁 Gift code preview straight on the home page, with one-click copy
🗂️ The community's best builds highlighted right from the home page
📅 An event calendar to follow what's running (preview)
📱 Navigation designed for mobile end to end
✨ A more polished and consistent look across the whole site

v2_1_0.title: Community build builder: create, share and vote
v2_1_0.description: New community platform: assemble your own builds (character, Demon Wedges, Genimon, weapon, skills and team), publish them through your Discord account, then browse and vote on other players' builds. Demon Wedge builds for all 65 weapons, card sharing, and a big accessibility and translation push.
items: 🛠️ New Builder: assemble a complete build (Demon Wedges, Genimon, weapon, skills, team of 3) and publish it
🔐 Discord sign-in to publish and vote; up to 3 builds per character
🌐 Community hub /builds: search, filters (character, element, tags), sorting and pagination
📄 A dedicated, shareable page for every build (/builds/[id])
👍 Votes and ranking for community builds
🏷️ Build tags: Solo, Team, Boss, F2P, Endgame, Beginner
👥 Recommended team picker (up to 3 characters with a role)
🔗 Build sharing: self-contained link + X / Facebook / Reddit + native share
🖼️ PNG export of the build card
🥇 A distinct “Official” tier, above community alternatives
💾 Hybrid drafts: saved locally, then reconciled with the server on sign-in
⚔️ Weapon Demon Wedge builds for all 65 weapons, visible on the weapon sheet and attachable to a build (toggle)
🎴 Richer tooltips when hovering Demon Wedges (name, rarity, element)
🔗 Filter state in the URL (shareable links and back/forward navigation)
♿ Stronger accessibility: global “reduce motion” support, visible focus, focus traps on dialogs, ARIA labels
📜 Privacy / Terms page and account deletion (GDPR)

v2_0_0.title: Patch 1.4 Silver Torrent, Rising Star: Flora, Hilda, Bloomfield Station and 5 new maps
v2_0_0.description: Full integration of the official “Silver Torrent, Rising Star” patch: 2 new characters (Flora and Hilda), a new Umbro element for the Phoxhunter, the Flodia Bloomfield Station steampunk region, 5 interactive maps, 12 wallpapers and an auto-expiring banner system.
items: 🎮 Full re-extraction of game data up to patch 1.4.153 “Silver Torrent, Rising Star”
✨ Flora (Umbro) — new featured character, wields sword and assault rifle
🔥 Hilda (Pyro) — new character, wields dual blades and grenade launcher (available after 30 June 2026)
🌑 New Umbro element unlocked for the Phoxhunter (player protagonist), via [Noctoyager Chapter – Silver Torrent, Rising Star]
🚂 New Flodia Bloomfield Station region (including Bloomfield Station and Ironworks), Icelake's steampunk railway station
⚔️ +27 skills, +18 Demon Wedges, +157 resources, new Calamity Weapons category, reworked fishing items
🗺️ 5 new interactive maps: Bloomfield Station, Ironworks, Outer Peaks, Taixu Mausoleum, Youlai Alley
📍 Resynced 1,589 marker icons from boarhat.gg across all 13 maps
🖼️ 12 new worldview wallpapers (7 from patch 1.3, 5 from patch 1.4) added to the Ken Burns effect
⚡ v1.3/v1.4 wallpaper optimisation: 4K → Full HD downscale, WebP q70 (-73% file size)
🌟 Reordered home carousel: the newest wallpapers show first
📢 New announcement banner system with automatic expiry 4 weeks after patch release (history kept in the code)
🎭 Rearranged character showcase: Flora featured, Su Yi, and both Umbro forms of the Phoxhunter
💾 Extraction pipeline refactor: pak storage and FModel exports moved to an external drive so the system SSD stops filling up

v1_9_0.title: Build cards, Skills tab and cursor tooltips
v1_9_0.description: A new per-character Skills tab with a level slider, build cards exportable to PNG, and a tooltip system that follows the cursor on desktop.
items: 🎴 New shareable build card (modal + ?build=true accordion) with feathered portrait, in-game Demon Wedge layout and PNG download
🃏 Build card showcase on the home page (Psyche) with a #build-showcase anchor and a teaser in the hero banner
⚔️ Complete Skills tab: name, description, parameters, sections, combat terms, in 7 languages
🎚️ Skill level slider (1-20) that recalculates level-dependent values live through SkillGrow
🧩 Inline skill icons and recommended team in the build card
🪄 New CursorTooltip component: follows the cursor on desktop, click-to-toggle on mobile, portalled into body
🛡️ Cursor tooltips on weapons, Genimons and Demon Wedge slots (centre included) of the build card
🏷️ extract-skills.ts extraction pipeline: parses 9 Lua files + SkillGrow, #N formulas evaluated for every level

v1_8_0.title: Internationalisation, character showcase and map deep-linking
v1_8_0.description: Major overhaul with full multilingual support (7 languages), a new interactive v1.3 character showcase, and improved navigation.
items: 🌐 Full site internationalisation with next-intl: 7 languages (FR, EN, DE, ES, JP, KR, TC)
🔍 Automatic browser language detection with the choice persisted in a cookie
🗂️ i18n routing: every language has its own URLs (/fr/map, /en/characters, etc.)
🌏 Language picker on every page of the site
🎭 New interactive v1.3 character showcase on the home page (Su Yi, Camilla, Yuming, Zhiliu)
🖼️ Full-screen artwork with avatar picker, per-character gradients and decorative calligraphic characters
🔗 Map deep-linking: the Haojing banner goes straight to the right map (?mapId=haojing)
📐 Fixed link wrapping in the map sidebar
🖼️ v1.3 image added to the hero banner's Ken Burns effect
⚡ turbopack.root fix to speed up dev compilation
🏷️ SEO: hreflang tags, localised metadata, multi-locale sitemap

v1_7_0.title: Game v1.3 update and Genimon variants
v1_7_0.description: Full re-extraction of game data from version 1.3, new characters added and a variant system for Genimons.
items: 🔄 Re-extracted 1,176 Lua files from the game's v1.3 paks
👤 Added Su Yi (complete with portraits and skills) and Flora (data only, not released yet)
🎭 Completed Camilla (stats, translations, portraits, skills)
🐾 Genimon variant system: every species shows its variants with cross-navigation
✨ Gold Premium badge for shiny Genimon variants
🎣 New fish from the Eastern region (Haojing) added
📦 Updated every item, mod and resource with v1.3 data
🌐 Fixed Spanish translations (Hyperboreano → Hiporboreo)

v1_6_0.title: New Haojing map (Patch 1.3)
v1_6_0.description: Added the Haojing map with 143 markers and a major optimisation of map data loading.
items: 🗺️ New Haojing map added (8th region) with 143 markers and 6 categories
⚡ Reworked data system: per-map on-demand loading instead of one monolithic file
📦 Initial payload cut by ~75% (54 KB index + 1 map instead of 439 KB)
🔧 Fixed the boarhat.gg parser to handle names containing quotes
🏠 New v1.3 banner on the home page for Haojing

v1_5_0.title: Character builds

items: 🎮 21 character builds added with recommended gear and Demon Wedges

🎚️ Track Adjustments with toggle and icons
🎨 Redesigned Intron tab with floating circles and skill priority

🖼️ Skill icons in the attributes tab
💡 Richer tooltips for build gear

🎣 New Fishing category with items extracted from the game data
🐾 Fixed dynamic values of Genimon passives
🌐 Text-key labels contextualised per item category

v1_2_1.title: New markers & SEO optimisation
v1_2_1.description: Added missing markers, notably the Taixu Runes, and fully migrated to local asset hosting.

✨ Added the Taixu Runes markers that were absent

🎨 Downloaded and locally hosted every icon

✅ 111 URLs fixed automatically in the existing maps

v1_2_0.title: Secure contact form with reCAPTCHA & Zod
v1_2_0.description: Complete and secure implementation of the contact form with advanced anti-spam protection.
items: 📧 Full API endpoint for secure form processing
🔒 reCAPTCHA v3 integration (score ≥ 0.7) for anti-bot protection
🛡️ Zod v4.3.5 validation with automatic sanitisation and type safety
📮 Secure SMTP configuration with professional HTML emails
⏱️ DoS protection: 30 s timeout + 10 KB limit + rate limiting
🔐 Complete security headers (XSS, framing, content-type)
✨ Improved UX: loading states, contextual error messages
🧹 Strict sanitisation: name regex, RFC-compliant email validation
🎯 Subject enum validation + injection protection
📊 Detailed logging for monitoring and security auditing

v1_1_1.title: Map improvements and transparency

items: 📸 Added 878 descriptive images for every older map

📋 Disclaimer added to the home page and inside the modal

✨ Improved interface with information on each individual map
